# Sobel edge normal estimates around circle at r=41.5
sob_x=cv2.Sobel(g,cv2.CV_32F,1,0,ksize=3);sob_y=cv2.Sobel(g,cv2.CV_32F,0,1,ksize=3)
for cx,cy in [(418,257),(418.5,257.5)]:
 vals=[];angs=[];scores=[]
 for ang in np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,720,endpoint=False):
  # sample r 39-44 find radial derivative magnitude max
  rs=np.arange(39,45,.2);xs=(cx+rs*np.cos(ang)).astype(int);ys=(cy+rs*np.sin(ang)).astype(int)
  # directional derivative normalized
  d=np.abs(sob_x[ys,xs]*np.cos(ang)+sob_y[ys,xs]*np.sin(ang))
  i=d.argmax();
  if d[i]>50: vals.append(rs[i]);angs.append(ang);scores.append(d[i])
 print('center',cx,cy,'num',len(vals),'r',np.percentile(vals,[10,25,50,75,90]))
 # fit circle LS to detected edge points
 pts=[]
 for ang in np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,720,endpoint=False):
